messages.subject: slider/numeric combo
parts:
For one input I'd like to display both a sliderInput and numericInput together side by side, and have them linked together. When either one changes, I want the other to also change. But if I make them reactive to each other it kicks off an infinite loop.

Does such a widget already exist?

Jonathan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: slider/numeric combo
parts:
It seems to work for me...?

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  sliderInput("slide", NULL, 0, 10, 1),
  numericInput("num", NULL, 1)
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    updateSliderInput(session, "slide", value = input$num)
  })
  
  observe({
    updateNumericInput(session, "num", value = input$slide)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
